description:
Candidate must be comfortable building, modifying and maintaining PHP web-based applications using traditional and Object Oriented (OO) methodologies. Additionally, candidate will require some experience with POJO development and relational database design. The ideal candidate will be enthusiastic, an excellent problem solver, possess outstanding communication skills, and have a basic understating of telecommunications with an interest in all things technology.  

 Skills 2+ years of experience in OO software development using JAVA/PHP is required. 3+ years of web development experience using JavaScript (jQuery), HTML and CSS is required. RDBMS experience (Oracle, MS SQL, MySQL etc..) including development of multi-tier solutions is required. Knowledge of Windows(IIS) and Linux(Apache, Nginx) is highly desired. Knowledge of the Linux command line. Ability to provide general technical support to users at a variety of technical levels. Ability to generate visual reports via charts, graphs, and spreadsheets. Mobile application development experience desired but not required. - Occasional travel. Technologies being utilized: JAVA, PHP, Linux, MVC-pattern (Codeigniter), MySQL, JavaScript/jQuery, HTML and CSS. Version control using SVN. Ability to organize and influence to gain efficiency, push for excellence, and get results Basic logic, math skills, and statistical analysis to perform detailed analysis Effective communication (verbal, written), and interpersonal, skills. Good planning and organizational skills. Good knowledge of the Services Organization and its responsibilities. Ability to build relationships with personnel from various organizations to support Network Rollout projects

 Start date – ASAP. 6 +  months contract.
years_evidence: Skills 2+ years of experience in OO software development using JAVA/PHP is required.
